notes: Standalone auxiliary engine only; no MASTER MARKET score impact.
Uses free public data only: ECB USDJPY cross, FRED/Fed H.15 US10Y, Japan MOF JP10Y, Cboe VIX.
If any required source is unavailable, final_score is null and the parent MASTER must continue without this auxiliary block.
No interpolation, no synthetic backfill, no reuse of stale values beyond each source-specific freshness threshold.
source_freshness_days uses calendar-day guards with weekend/holiday buffer; max_source_age_days is retained only as a backward-compatible fallback.
